eng-release-bot: Weekly Release Train digest — 2026-03-23. Heads up: rolling release freeze window starts Fri 2026-03-27 22:00 UTC -> Mon 2026-03-30 06:00 UTC for global deploys. Exceptions require release-captain signoff. Canary window extended for Embeddings pipeline due to perf variance. Current canary metrics: error budget used 2.4%, p95 latency 220ms (target <250ms).

jessica: TL;DR — freeze covers major branch merges, schema migrations, and infra rolling restarts. Small hotpatches ok if signed off by @ranjit + release-captain. :white_check_mark:

ranjit: Confirming hotpatch flow: open PR -> add label release/hotpatch -> ping this thread + mention release-captain -> deploy to canary first. Should I drop the checklist here?

olivia: Note: canary variance traced to tail latency on g4dn hosts in staging after a kernel rollout. Ops are pinning kernels on canary hosts now. Posting runbook link shortly.

mike: FYI embeddings-e2e flake just appeared: reproducer log snippet: ```Error: KV cache mismatch on shard 7
  at kvCache.sync (/srv/service/cache.js:142:13)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:97:5)``` Investigating whether this is related to the recent batching change.

jessica: @mike thanks — if this blocks embeddings rollout we will PAUSE embeddings deployments until cleared. @eng-release-bot please set canary state to PAUSED for embeddings-model:v2.1 for now.

eng-release-bot: Canary update: embeddings-model:v2.1 -> PAUSED. Notifying on-call and enabling rollback alarms (thresholds configured).

olivia: Ops runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/release-train/runbooks/canary-tail-latency — added kernel pin instructions and a quick verification script (run on canary hosts).

ranjit: Quick reminder on rollback thresholds we follow during this train: immediate rollback if error-rate >4% OR p95 latency increase >40% vs baseline sustained >5m. For infra maintenance exceptions we can extend gates with @exec-approval.

jessica: Scheduling a 30m sync Tue 2026-03-24 16:00 PT to triage canary telemetry + freeze exceptions. Invite sent to release-captains + oncall. Agenda: canary status, hotpatch approvals, rollback playbook. Ping me if you want to add items.

eng-release-bot: Short deploy gate checklist for reference:
1) CI green (all suites)
2) Telemetry sanity (no regressions in key signals)
3) Release notes + release-captain approval
4) Backout playbook linked in PR
Run `/release-check <pr>` to validate pre-deploy checks.

jessica: Thanks all — please escalate any surprises in this thread. Will post a follow-up after the sync with final freeze exceptions. :wave:
